pidgey-tailwind.name: Tailwind
pidgey-tailwind.description: Bond skill: whips up a tailwind; it and allies within 2 hexes are Hasted for 2 turns.

pidgey-brave-bird.name: Brave Bird
pidgey-brave-bird.description: Bond skill: dives at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 100, Attack) and engages it.

pidgey-hurricane.name: Hurricane
pidgey-hurricane.description: Bond skill: a raging wind at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 95), pushing it 1 hex.

pidgey-big-pecks.name: Big Pecks
pidgey-big-pecks.description: Its guard can't be lowered: cannot be Exposed or Marked.

pidgey-sharp-eyes.name: Sharp Eyes
pidgey-sharp-eyes.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away.

pidgey-agility.name: Agility
pidgey-agility.description: New skill: relaxes its body to move faster and becomes Hasted for 2 turns.

pidgey-steel-wing.name: Steel Wing
pidgey-steel-wing.description: New skill: strikes a foe with hardened wings (Power 65).

pidgey-pursuit.name: Pursuit
pidgey-pursuit.description: Its free strikes on foes breaking away deal 25% more damage.

pidgey-updraft.name: Updraft
pidgey-updraft.description: Rides an updraft: steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

pidgey-air-cutter.name: Air Cutter
pidgey-air-cutter.description: New skill: razor-sharp wind on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 50).

pidgey-swoop.name: Swoop
pidgey-swoop.description: Regains 1 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

pidgey-gusting-wings.name: Gusting Wings
pidgey-gusting-wings.description: Pushes it causes go 1 hex farther.

pidgey-sky-attack.name: Sky Attack
pidgey-sky-attack.description: New skill: a glowing plunge on a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 95) that engages it.

pidgey-hyper-beam.name: Hyper Beam
pidgey-hyper-beam.description: New skill: a devastating beam at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 85).

pidgey-birds-eye-view.name: Bird's-Eye View
pidgey-birds-eye-view.description: Its ranged moves fire over Pokémon standing in the way.

pidgey-raptor.name: Raptor
pidgey-raptor.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes engaged with one of its allies.

pidgey-air-slash.name: Air Slash
pidgey-air-slash.description: New skill: a blade of air at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 85).

pidgey-double-edge.name: Double-Edge
pidgey-double-edge.description: New skill: a reckless full-body charge into a foe (Power 95).

pidgey-relentless-hunter.name: Relentless Hunter
pidgey-relentless-hunter.description: Deals 10% more damage per consecutive hit on the same foe (up to 3).

pidgey-flock-leader.name: Flock Leader
pidgey-flock-leader.description: Each knockout it lands gives the team 1 Bond.

pidgey-sovereign-of-the-sky.name: Sovereign of the Sky
pidgey-sovereign-of-the-sky.description: Capstone. Rules the skies: its Flying moves deal 25% more damage.

pidgey-raptors-fury.name: Raptor's Fury
pidgey-raptors-fury.description: Capstone. Deals 10% more damage; a knockout on its turn lets it use its basic attack again.

pidgey-sand-attack.name: Sand Attack
pidgey-sand-attack.description: New skill: kicks sand at a foe up to 2 hexes away, leaving it Weakened for 1 turn.
